row: My name is David Orlando and I am a licensed chiropractor in the Atlanta Georgia metro area. I have been practicing chiropractic for 28 years and I am insanely passionate about helping and serving my patient base. If you would have asked me a few years ago to do videos about what I do, I probably would have never even considered it. However, now is a new time and I am so excited to share with the world the wealth of knowledge and experience I have gained over the years. I am equally excited to showcase my work as I believe it really isn't my work but my "calling." I hope you will enjoy my channel and please comment, and let me know what you would like to see. I will do my utmost  to bring valuable, educational content that most will enjoy. "ATL cracks with Dr. O. Get addicted to the crack." Transforming peoples lives so they may have the absolute best quality of life possible. Thank you so much for checking out my channel I promise it will just get better and better!
